resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the present 100-foot tower to 1949. A 1933 trade report credits a CCC crew with an 80-foot tower and a 1946 photograph shows a lookout on the site, but no source says whether these are one structure or several. The record keeps 1949 for the present tower only.
The register gives 3,362 ft (1,025 m) and PeakBagging gives 3,380 ft. The brief keeps the register figure of 1,024.7 m; the story does not use an elevation.

notes_for_editor: Early history is unresolved: the 1933 80-foot tower, the 1946 lookout photograph and the 1949 100-foot tower are all in the record, and the story says so. Access is restricted per the register's 'secure facility' wording; no visiting information was found and none is given. The 1933, 1938 and 1955 items are read only through the californialookouts compilation. Waymarking and academia.edu pages could not be read. The archive.org photo (public domain, Aug 1946, W. Fairbank) is a candidate image, but only its details page was captured, so no photos entry was added. The 30.5 m height is converted from the register's 100 ft.
